thread.title: SCHWEIZER: Even for Non-Catholics, the Next Pope Matters
thread.title_full: SCHWEIZER: Even for Non-Catholics, the Next Pope Matters

author: cochise1
text:
I typed it all by hand on my phone from memory.
I understand the concepts of evolution, and if you try to conflate microevolution (change within species/kind) with macroevolution (change from one species/kind to another) then you're the one in error.
Evolutionary concepts contend with origins and the matter of death before sin. It argues against Adam as the first man. Stellar evolutionary concepts are at odds with scripture and observations.
I could go on, and on, and on.
I understand that you're not Catholic, however, even if you are not, I highly recommend a resource to watch if you wish to see my side of argument.
The Kolbe Center has produced a relatively good presentation of both sides of matter. It's called "Foundations Restored: A Catholic Perspective on Origins."
If you get bored one day and want to see the best counter argument available for the modern conception of biological and stellar evolution, give it a shot.
